features.title: Eval validation, breakdowns, baseline, harvest
features.user_visible_behavior: Maintainers validate cases, compare scores with a baseline, and turn real reviews into private cases.
verification: cd tools/spec-drift && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test
features.evidence: tools/spec-drift: typecheck OK; lint no errors (2 warnings + 1 info pre-existing); pnpm test 122/122. eval-score.spec: per-language/category breakdown, compareWithBaseline flags a 6-point precision drop and passes a 4-point one (and a 10-point recall drop), repeated noise counted. eval-cases.spec: validateCase passes a label on an added line with a known rule; reports a context-line label, unknown rule, file not in the diff, id/file mismatch, missing language; caseFromReview gives 2 defects (kept, edited) + 1 noise (removed) and copies no comment text. scripts/eval.mts: check, score --json/--baseline/--max-drop, harvest (default $PR_REVIEW_ROOT/eval-cases; refuses inside the repo without --allow-repo) — tried on a real review into a temp dir (1 clean case, check OK), then deleted.

features.title: Evaluation set
features.user_visible_behavior: At least 30 validated cases across 6+ languages, a third clean.
verification: cd tools/spec-drift && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test
features.evidence: eval/cases: 35 cases (32 new + 3 seeds given language/category), 9 languages (typescript, python, go, java, csharp, rust, php, yaml/GitHub Actions, terraform), 12 clean, 23 with one labelled defect each across security, correctness, error-handling, resources, concurrency, async, tests. Generated from before/after sources with labels by unique substring (no client code). pnpm eval check: 0 problems; eval-set.spec (every case validates and yields >= 1 review group; >= 30 cases, >= 6 languages, >= 1/3 clean) in pnpm test 158/158; typecheck OK; lint no errors.
